description:
I am a graduate of Bachelor of Science in Information Engineering Technology (BSc-IET) from National Skills University, Islamabad, and a registered Engineering Technologist (Engr. Technologist).

I am an Android and Flutter Developer with experience in mobile app development, Project Management, and Software Quality Assurance (SQA). I am passionate about technology, problem-solving, and continuous learning. I also have an interest in leadership, teamwork, and community development.
